<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Directions for the Completion of the Subscription Documents </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">(for Institutional Subscribers) </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">The attached Subscription Agreement (including the Annexes and Exhibits attached thereto, the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Subscription
Documents</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>) relates to the offering by TCW Specialty Lending IX LLC (the &#8220;<I><U>Fund</U></I>&#8221;) to you (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Subscriber</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>) of common limited liability company units
(<I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Units</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>) in the Fund. Capitalized terms not defined in these directions shall have the meanings given to them in the Subscription Agreement. <B>Subscription Documents that are missing requested information or
signatures will not be considered for acceptance unless and until such information or signatures are provided. Subscribers may be required to furnish other or additional documentation evidencing the authority to invest in the Fund. In addition, the
Fund may require additional information from a subscriber in order to verify its &#8220;accredited investor&#8221; status and other representations made in the Subscription Agreement.</B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B>PLEASE TYPE OR USE LEGIBLE BLOCK CAPITALS WHEN COMPLETING THE SUBSCRIPTION DOCUMENTS. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>1.&#8195;&#8195;<U>Subscriber Information.</U> </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.1.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><B></B>Fill in the name of the Subscriber and the Commitment on the cover page hereof.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.2.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><B></B>All Subscribers must complete the enclosed Subscriber Questionnaire (Annex I). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.3.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><B></B>Fill in the name of the Subscriber and the date (print name and title of authorized signatory) of the
Subscription Agreement and sign in the blank provided. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.4.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><B></B>Carefully review the Electronic Communication and Signature Authorization (Annex II).
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>1.5.</B><B></B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><B></B>If you are an existing Unitholder and you wish to increase your capital commitment, please complete
the Additional Commitment Form (Annex III). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B>2.</B>&#8195;&#8195;<B><U>Required IRS Certifications for all
Subscribers.</U></B> Fill in, sign (print name and title of authorized signatory, if applicable) and date an IRS Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-9</FONT> if you are a Subscriber that is a &#8220;United States person&#8221; (as defined in the
Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the &#8220;<B><I>Code</I></B>&#8221;)) (a &#8220;<B><I>U.S. Subscriber</I></B>&#8221;). If you are a Subscriber that is not a &#8220;United States person&#8221; (as defined in the Code) (a
&#8220;<B><I>Foreign Subscriber</I></B>&#8221;), please provide a signed and completed appropriate Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8.</FONT> </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>3.</B><B></B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><B></B>If the Adviser accepts your subscription (in whole or in part), the Adviser will countersign the
Subscription Agreement and deliver a copy of it to you at the address you provide in the Subscription Documents. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Please note that the attached Subscription Documents contain a power of attorney which enables the Adviser to execute
documents relating to the Subscriber&#8217;s investments in the Fund on behalf of the Subscriber. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>4.</B><B></B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><B></B><B><U>Inquiries</U></B>. If you have questions concerning any of the information requested, you
should ask your attorney, accountant or other financial advisor. Inquiries regarding subscription procedures should be directed to the Adviser at (213) 244-0020, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail:</FONT>
<FONT COLOR="#0000ff"><U>PrivateFunds@tcw.com</U></FONT>. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Please type or print all information you supply. </B></P>

THE COMMITMENT APPLIED FOR BY THE UNDERSIGNED AND SET FORTH ON THE SIGNATURE PAGE HERETO) IN WHOLE OR IN PART. </B></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman">TCW Specialty Lending IX LLC </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">The undersigned subscriber (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Subscriber</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>) understands that TCW
Specialty Lending IX LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Fund</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>) has been formed for the purpose of investing in various types of investments as described in the registration statement on Form 10,
as may be amended, of the Fund (the &#8220;<I>Registration Statement</I>&#8221;), the Confidential Private Placement Memorandum of the Fund, as may be amended (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>PPM</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>), the Amended and Restated Limited
Liability Company Agreement that will govern the Fund from and after the Closing, as amended, in the form previously furnished to you (together with the organizational documents of any Parallel Funds, being herein referred to as the
<I>&#8220;</I><I><U>LLC Agreement</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>), as such documents may be amended, amended and restated or supplemented from time to time (together with the Registration Statement and the PPM, the &#8220;<I>Offering Documents</I>&#8221;).
The Subscriber further understands that the Fund is offering to the Subscriber the opportunity to subscribe for common limited liability company units in the Fund (<I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Units</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>). As used in this agreement, the term
&#8220;<I><U>Adviser</U></I>&#8221; shall refer to TCW Asset Management Company LLC, a Delaware limited liability company. Capitalized terms used in this Subscription Agreement (this <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Subscription Agreement</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>)
without definition will have the meanings given in the LLC Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B>1.</B>&#8195;<B>&#8195;<U>Subscription for
Units</U></B>.<B> </B>The Subscriber hereby subscribes for the commitment in the amount set forth above (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Commitment</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>), subject to the below Section&nbsp;10.13, on the terms described or appearing in the
Offering Documents (it being understood that if the subscription is partially accepted, the Fund will amend this Subscription Agreement to reduce the above number of Units and corresponding Commitment to reflect the number of Units to be issued to
the Subscriber). Subject to the terms of this Subscription Agreement and of the LLC Agreement, the Subscriber&#8217;s obligation to pay for the Units it is purchasing hereunder shall be unconditional, complete and binding upon the completion of the
Closing (as defined below), provided, however, that for the convenience of the Fund, the Subscriber&#8217;s Commitment shall be payable in capital contributions as provided in Article 6 of the LLC Agreement. The Subscriber agrees to become a
unitholder and to be bound by the terms and provisions of the LLC Agreement in the final form provided to the Subscriber and this Subscription Agreement, and the Subscriber and the Adviser agree that the Subscriber shall be admitted as a unitholder,
in each case on the Closing Date (as defined below). Subject to the terms hereof and of the LLC Agreement, the Subscriber&#8217;s obligation to make capital contributions hereunder shall be unconditional, complete and binding upon the Closing Date
(as defined below). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B>2.</B>&#8195;&#8195;<B><U>Other Subscription Agreements</U></B>.<B> </B>The Subscriber
acknowledges that the Fund has entered into or expects to enter into separate subscription agreements (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Other Subscription Agreements</U></I><I>&#8221;</I><I> </I>and, together with this Subscription Agreement, the
<I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Subscription Agreements</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>) with other subscribers (<I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Other Subscribers</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>), providing for the sale to Other Subscribers of Units in the Fund and the admission of the Other
Subscribers as Members at the Closing or at other closings. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B>3.</B>&#8195;&#8195;<B><U>Closing</U></B>.<B> </B>The closing of the sale
to the Subscriber of Units as provided for in Section&nbsp;1, and the admission of the Subscriber as a Member (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Closing</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>), shall take place via electronic submission (the date of such acceptance, which
shall be indicated on the signature page hereto, being hereinafter referred to as the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Closing Date</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>) </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B>4.</B>&#8195;&#8195;<B>Later-Closing Investors. </B>During the Closing Period, the Company may, in the Board&#8217;s
discretion, issue additional Common Units to newly admitted Members (a &#8220;<I><U>Later-Closing Investor</U></I>&#8221;) or to existing Members (who will be treated as Later-Closing Investors with respect to such newly issued Common Units);
<I>provided</I>, however, investors admitted as Initial Closing Members that participate in a closing following the Initial Closing Date, and existing Members receiving newly issued Common Units because their initial commitment did not reflect their
total commitment due to regulatory, legal, or other constraints applicable to the Company&#8217;s or investor&#8217;s portfolio at the time of initial commitment, shall not be deemed Later-Closing Investors. Later-Closing Investor status shall be
determined on a look-through basis with respect to any feeder fund. In advance of each additional closing, and as close to it as practicable, the Company will allocate its estimated profits and losses through that date, and distribute to Unitholders
any undistributed estimated profits in cash to the extent there is available cash and through a deemed capital call and corresponding deemed distribution to the extent there is not sufficient available cash (on each occasion, a &#8220;<I><U><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Closing</FONT> Distribution</U></I>&#8221;). Each Later-Closing Investor will be required to contribute to the Company in respect of each newly issued Common Unit the sum of the following: </P>

Contribution</U></I>&#8221;); and </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

standing as a limited liability company under the laws of the State of Delaware, has or will have prior to commencement of operations all requisite power and authority to carry on its business as now conducted and as proposed to be conducted as
described in the Offering Documents and is duly qualified to transact business and is or will be prior to commencement of operations in good standing in every jurisdiction in which the character of its business makes such qualification necessary,

executed and delivered </P>

Information</U></B>. The Subscriber hereby acknowledges it has been provided with, and has carefully reviewed, the Offering Documents. The Subscriber understands the risks of, and other considerations relating to, the purchase of Units, including,
without limitation, the information appearing in the Private Placement Memorandum under the headings <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Investment Considerations</U></I><I>,</I><I>&#8221;</I><I> </I><I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Material U.S. Federal Income Tax

(relating to Members that default on their obligations to make capital contributions) and Section&nbsp;11.4 of the LLC Agreement (relating to the obligation of Members to return to the Fund certain distributions to satisfy certain obligations of the
Fund). The Subscriber also has been afforded the opportunity to obtain any additional information necessary to verify the accuracy of the information in the Offering Documents to the extent the Fund possesses such information or can acquire it
without unreasonable effort or expense. The Fund has answered all of the Subscriber&#8217;s inquiries, if any, concerning the business to be conducted by the Fund, the financial condition and capital of the Fund, the qualification and experience of
the Fund and its Members, and the terms and conditions of the offering and other matters pertaining to this investment. In deciding to acquire Units, the Subscriber has not relied upon any information or representation, whether written or oral, from
the Fund, the Adviser or any of their partners, members, directors, officers, counsel, representatives or agents or any other Person, other than information contained in the Offering Documents and in the answers provided by the Fund to such
inquiries. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.4&#8195;&#8195;<B><U>Evaluation and Ability to Bear
Risks</U></B>. The Subscriber&#8217;s decision to invest in the Fund was made by the Subscriber as person(s) who (a)&nbsp;are independent of the Fund and the Adviser and their respective affiliates, (b)&nbsp;are authorized to make such investment
decisions, and (c)&nbsp;have relied on their own tax, legal and financial advisers with regard to all matters relating to the Subscriber&#8217;s investment in the Fund (including federal, state and local tax matters) and not on any advice or
recommendation of the Fund or the Adviser or any of their respective affiliates, notwithstanding anything in Section&nbsp;6.3 to the contrary. The Subscriber&#8217;s prior investment experience and its general knowledge about the management,
proposed operations and prospects of the Fund enable the Subscriber, together with the Subscriber&#8217;s advisers, to make an informed decision with respect to the merits and risks of an investment in the Fund. After all necessary advice and
analysis, the Subscriber has evaluated the risks of investing in Units and has determined that the Units are a suitable investment for the Subscriber. The Subscriber has adequate means for providing for its current needs and other contingencies and
has no need for liquidity with regards to its investment in Units, and is able to bear the economic risk of its acquisition of Units, including a complete loss of its investment in the Fund. The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that it is not a
client of the Adviser and the Adviser is providing services solely to the Fund, including any reporting or consultation with investors thereof. The Subscriber understands that at the time of the Subscriber&#8217;s investment, the Fund does not know
in what portfolio investments the Fund will invest the Subscriber&#8217;s capital, and the Fund will have complete control (subject to the provisions of the LLC Agreement) over the investments made by it. The Subscriber has not reproduced,
duplicated or delivered the Offering Documents to any other person, except professional advisors to the Subscriber or as instructed by the Fund. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.5&#8195;&#8195;<B><U>Purchase of an Investment</U></B>. The Subscriber represents and warrants that it is
acquiring Units for investment purposes only and not with a view to the resale or distribution of all or any portion of such Units and the Subscriber has no present intention, agreement or arrangement to divide its participation with others or to
sell, assign, transfer or otherwise dispose of, directly or indirectly, all or any portion of such Units. Each Subscriber agrees that if it determines to transfer or assign any of its Units in the Fund pursuant to the provisions hereof and of the
LLC Agreement, it will cause its proposed transferee to agree to the transfer restrictions and make the representations set forth herein. The Subscriber understands that it must bear the economic risk of its investment in Units for an indefinite
period of time, because, among other reasons, the offering and sale of Units has not been registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the <I>&#8220;</I><I><U>Securities Act</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>), or any state securities laws within the
United States or the securities law of any other jurisdiction, and therefore Units may not be resold or otherwise disposed of unless such sale or disposition is registered thereunder or an exemption from registration is available. The Subscriber
also understands that the Fund is under no obligation to register the Units on its behalf or to assist it in complying with any exemption from registration under the Securities Act. The Subscriber further understands that transfers of Units are
further restricted by the provisions of the LLC Agreement, by requirements imposed by the Fund&#8217;s creditor(s), and potentially by applicable state and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> securities laws. No market exists or is
expected to develop for the Units, the LLC Agreement places certain restrictions on the withdrawal of funds from the Fund by the Members. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.6&#8195;&#8195;<I>Reserved.</I> </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.10.3 &#8194;If the Subscriber is acting on behalf of one or more clients in connection with this subscription, the

that such client(s) are NOT Prohibited Investors as defined in Section&nbsp;6.10.1; and (d)&nbsp;retained and will continue to retain evidence of any such identities, any such source of funds or any such diligence as required by the USA PATRIOT Act
and related regulations. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.10.4 &#8194;The Subscriber represents and warrants that the Subscriber does not know or have
any reason to suspect that (a)&nbsp;the monies used to fund the Subscriber&#8217;s acquisition of Units have been or will be derived from or related to any illegal activities, including but not limited to, money laundering activities or (b)&nbsp;the

acknowledges that, to the fullest extent </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.10.8&#8195;The Subscriber hereby understands that to help the United States government fight the funding of terrorism and
money laundering activities, federal law requires all financial institutions to obtain, verify and record information that identifies each Subscriber who opens an account, all as set forth on Annex I. The responses provided on such Annex are deemed

applicable jurisdiction, (ii)&nbsp;the offering and sale of the Fund of Funds Interests is exempt from the Securities Act, pursuant to Section&nbsp;4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Regulation D thereunder, (iii)&nbsp;the Fund of Funds has not

Agreement and replaced with a valid and enforceable provision as similar in intent as reasonably possible to the provision so severed, and shall not cause the invalidity or unenforceability of
the remainder of this Subscription Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; text-indent:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">10.12&#8195;&#8194;<B><U>Entire Agreement</U></B>. This
Subscription Agreement, together with its Attachments (which Attachments are incorporated in this Subscription Agreement by reference), the LLC Agreement and any other agreements pursuant to Section&nbsp;12.1.5 of the LLC Agreement, constitute the
entire agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter hereof, and any other prior or contemporaneous written or oral agreements, statements or assurances with respect to this subject matter are hereby rescinded and
terminated. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; text-indent:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">10.13&#8194;&#8195;<B><U>Irrevocability and Acceptance</U></B>. This Subscription Agreement
is and shall be irrevocable by the undersigned but will not be binding on the Fund unless and until it is agreed to and accepted by an authorized representative of the Fund. The Fund in its sole discretion may accept this Subscription Agreement with
respect to the Commitment in whole or in part. Acceptance will be given either by delivery of this Subscription Agreement to the Subscriber with the form of acceptance executed by the Fund or by such execution and written notice thereof to the
Subscriber. The Subscriber agrees that by its execution, or execution on its behalf, of this Subscription Agreement and the LLC Agreement and upon acceptance hereof by an authorized representative of the Fund, it agrees to be bound by terms of the
LLC Agreement and shall become a Member of the Fund. This Subscription Agreement will expire if it is not accepted by an authorized representative of the Fund on or prior to eight months from the date Subscriber has executed this Subscription
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; text-indent:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">10.14&#8194;&#8195;<B><U>Counterparts; Facsimile Signatures</U></B>. This Subscription
Agreement may be executed in several counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original but all of which shall constitute one and the same instrument. Facsimile counterpart signatures to this Subscription Agreement shall be acceptable and
binding. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; text-indent:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">10.15&#8194;&#8195;<B><U>Escheatment</U></B>. Your Fund account may be transferred to the
appropriate state if no activity occurs in your account within the time period specified by state law. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; text-indent:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">10.16&#8195;&#8194;<B><U>FATCA</U></B>. The Subscriber shall provide the Fund with any information,
representations, certificates or forms relating to such Subscriber (or its direct or indirect owners or account holders) that are requested from time to time by the Fund and that it determines are necessary or appropriate in connection with any
requirement imposed under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance provisions of the Hiring Incentives to Restore Employment Act, as enacted in Sections 1471 through 1474 of the Code, and any rules, regulations or other guidance issued thereunder
(<I>&#8220;</I><I><U>FATCA</U></I><I>&#8221;</I>). </P>

parties, except where we believe in good faith that disclosure is required or permitted by law. Because we do not disclose your nonpublic personal and financial information to nonaffiliated third parties, our Customer Privacy Policy does not contain

<TD VALIGN="top" STYLE="BORDER-BOTTOM:1px solid #002563;"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:6pt">&#8195;</P></TD></TR>
</TABLE></DIV> <P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-right:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><FONT COLOR="#002563">INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-right:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><FONT COLOR="#595959">Because the internet and our operations are global, Customer Data may be transferred to, processed in,
and held in countries (including the United States) other than the one in which you reside. The EEA and the UK do not consider the United States and many other countries to provide essentially equivalent privacy protections. Such transfers are a
necessary part of the services that we provide. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-right:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><FONT COLOR="#595959">We will ensure application of the same
standards of privacy protection as set out in this Privacy Policy regardless of the international transfer or processing of Customer Data. To the extent required by, and in accordance with, applicable data protection laws, we rely on appropriate or
suitable safeguards in respect of international transfers of Customer Data, including: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-size:8pt" COLOR="#595959">&#9726;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><FONT COLOR="#595959">Using standard contractual clauses approved by relevant authorities as ensuring
adequate safeguards. </FONT></P></TD>

about the possible risks of such a transfer. </FONT></P></TD>

or if the transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract between us and a third party, and the contract was entered into in your interest. </FONT></P></TD>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-right:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><FONT COLOR="#002563">HOW LONG DO WE RETAIN CUSTOMER DATA? </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-right:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><FONT COLOR="#595959">We retain Customer Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy
Policy, subject to your rights, under certain circumstances, to have your Customer Data erased. When deciding how long to retain Customer Data, we take into account our legal and regulatory obligations, the amount, nature and sensitivity of the
Customer Data, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure of Customer Data, the purposes for which we process Customer Data and whether we can achieve those purposes through other means. We may also retain Customer Data to
investigate or defend against potential legal claims in accordance with the limitation periods of countries where legal action may be brought. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV ALIGN="right">

<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-right:7%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><FONT COLOR="#595959">Individuals in the EEA and the UK, and individuals in other jurisdictions whose Customer Data is
subject to the GDPR and/or the UK GDPR, have certain rights in relation to their Customer Data. Subject to certain limitations, these rights include the right for individuals to: (i)&nbsp;request access to and rectification or erasure of their
Customer Data; (ii)&nbsp;restrict or object to the processing of their Customer Data; and (iii)&nbsp;obtain a copy of their Customer Data in a portable format. Individuals may also have the right to lodge a complaint about the processing of Customer
Data with a data protection or supervisory authority. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV ALIGN="right">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Appendix B </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>List of &#8220;Bad Acts&#8221; </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">For purposes of Section&nbsp;6.13 of the Subscription Agreement to which this document is appended, a person described in such paragraph shall
have committed a &#8220;Bad Act&#8221; if any of the following is true with respect to such person: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(i)&nbsp;Has been convicted, within
ten years before such sale (or five years, in the case of issuers, their predecessors and affiliated issuers), of any felony or misdemeanor: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(A)&nbsp;In connection with the purchase or sale of any security; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(B)&nbsp;Involving the making of any false filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the
&#8220;<B><I>Commission</I></B>&#8221;); or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(C)&nbsp;Arising out of the conduct of the business of an underwriter,
broker, dealer, municipal securities dealer, investment adviser or paid solicitor of purchasers of securities; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(ii)&nbsp;Is subject to
any order, judgment or decree of any court of competent jurisdiction, entered within five years before such sale, that, at the time of such sale, restrains or enjoins such person from engaging or continuing to engage in any conduct or practice: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(A)&nbsp;In connection with the purchase or sale of any security; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(B)&nbsp;Involving the making of any false filing with the Commission; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(C)&nbsp;Arising out of the conduct of the business of an underwriter, broker, dealer, municipal securities dealer, investment
adviser or paid solicitor of purchasers of securities; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iii)&nbsp;Is subject to a final order of a state securities commission (or an
agency or officer of a state performing like functions); a state authority that supervises or examines banks, savings associations, or credit unions; a state insurance commission (or an agency or officer of a state performing like functions); an
appropriate federal banking agency; the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission; or the National Credit Union Administration that: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(A)&nbsp;At the time of such sale, bars the person from: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(1)&nbsp;Association with an entity regulated by such commission, authority, agency, or officer; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(2)&nbsp;Engaging in the business of securities, insurance or banking; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(3)&nbsp;Engaging in savings association or credit union activities; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(B)&nbsp;Constitutes a final order based on a violation of any law or regulation that prohibits fraudulent, manipulative, or
deceptive conduct entered within ten years before such sale; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">25 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iv)&nbsp;Is subject to an order of the Commission entered pursuant to Section&nbsp;15(b) or
15B(c) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78o(b) or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">78o-4(c))</FONT> or Section&nbsp;203(e) or (f)&nbsp;of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C.
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">80b-3(e)</FONT> or (f)) that, at the time of such sale: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(A)&nbsp;Suspends or revokes
such person&#8217;s registration as a broker, dealer, municipal securities dealer or investment adviser; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(B)&nbsp;Places
limitations on the activities, functions or operations of such person; or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(C)&nbsp;Bars such person from being associated
with any entity or from participating in the offering of any penny stock; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(v)&nbsp;Is subject to any order of the Commission entered
within five years before such sale that, at the time of such sale, orders the person to cease and desist from committing or causing a violation or future violation of: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(A)&nbsp;Any scienter-based anti-fraud provision of the federal securities laws, including without limitation
Section&nbsp;17(a)(1) of the Securities Act of 1933 (15 U.S.C. 77q(a)(1)), Section&nbsp;10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78j(b)) and 17 CFR 240.10b-5, Section&nbsp;15(c)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C.
78o(c)(1)) and Section&nbsp;206(1) of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C. <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">80b-6(1)),</FONT> or any other rule or regulation thereunder; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(B)&nbsp;Section 5 of the Securities Act of 1933 (15 U.S.C. 77e). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(vi)&nbsp;Is suspended or expelled from membership in, or suspended or barred from association with a member of, a registered national
securities exchange or a registered national or affiliated securities association for any act or omission to act constituting conduct inconsistent with just and equitable principles of trade; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(vii)&nbsp;Has filed (as a registrant or issuer), or was or was named as an underwriter in, any registration statement or Regulation A
offering statement filed with the Commission that, within five years before such sale, was the subject of a refusal order, stop order, or order suspending the Regulation&nbsp;A exemption, or is, at the time of such sale, the subject of an
investigation or proceeding to determine whether a stop order or suspension order should be issued; or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(viii)&nbsp;Is subject to a United
States Postal Service false representation order entered within five years before such sale, or is, at the time of such sale, subject to a temporary restraining order or preliminary injunction with respect to conduct alleged by the United States
Postal Service to constitute a scheme or device for obtaining money or property through the mail by means of false representations. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">If
the Subscriber has been subject to such an event but, prior to the date hereof, (i)&nbsp;the court or regulatory authority that entered the relevant order, judgment or decree has advised in writing (whether contained in the relevant judgment, order
or decree or separately to the Commission or its staff) that disqualification under paragraph (d)(1) of Rule 506 under the Securities Act should not arise as a consequence of such order, judgment or decree or (ii)&nbsp;the Commission has issued an
exemption from paragraph (d)(1) of Rule 506 with respect to such event, a copy of such order, judgment, decree or exemption is attached to this certificate. </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Appendix C </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Definition of &#8220;Investments&#8221; </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">The term &#8220;<I>investments</I>&#8221; means: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(1)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">Securities, other than securities of an issuer that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control
with, the prospective qualified purchaser that owns such securities, unless the issuer of such securities is: </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">an investment company or a company that would be an investment company but for the exclusions provided by
Sections 3(c)(1) through 3(c)(9) of the Investment Company Act or the exemptions provided by Rule 3a-6 or 3a-7 promulgated under the Investment Company Act, or a commodity pool; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">a Public Company (as defined below); or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">a company with shareholders&#8217; equity of not less than $50,000,000 (determined in accordance with
generally accepted accounting principles) as reflected on the company&#8217;s most recent (and in any event not more than sixteen months old) financial statements; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(2)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">Real estate held for investment purposes; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(3)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">Commodity Interests (as defined below) held for investment purposes; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(4)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">Physical Commodities (as defined below) held for investment purposes; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(5)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">To the extent not securities, Financial Contracts (as defined below) entered into for investment purposes;
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(6)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">In the case of a prospective qualified purchaser that is a company that would be an investment company but
for the exclusions provided by Section&nbsp;3(c)(1) or 3(c)(7) of the Investment Company Act, or a commodity pool, any amounts payable to such prospective qualified purchaser pursuant to a firm agreement or similar binding commitment pursuant to
which a person has agreed to acquire an interest in, or make capital contributions to, the prospective qualified purchaser upon the demand of the prospective qualified purchaser; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(7)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">Cash and cash equivalents held for investment purposes. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Real estate that is used by the prospective qualified purchaser or a Related Person (as defined below) of the prospective
qualified purchaser for personal purposes, or as a place of business, or in connection with the conduct of the trade or business of such prospective qualified purchaser or a Related Person of the prospective qualified purchaser, will NOT be
considered real estate held for investment purposes, <I>provided </I>that real estate owned by a prospective qualified purchaser who is engaged primarily in the business of investing, trading or developing real estate in connection with such
business may be deemed to be held for investment purposes. However, residential real estate will not be deemed to be used for personal purposes if deductions with respect to such real estate are not disallowed by section 280A of the Code. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">27 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">A Commodity Interest or Physical Commodity owned, or a Financial Contract
entered into, by the prospective qualified purchaser who is engaged primarily in the business of investing, reinvesting, or trading in Commodity Interests, Physical Commodities or Financial Contracts in connection with such business may be deemed to
be held for investment purposes. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">For purposes of determining the amount of investments owned by a prospective qualified
purchaser that is a company, there may be included investments owned by majority-owned subsidiaries of the prospective qualified purchaser and investments owned by a company (&#8220;<I><U>Parent Company</U></I>&#8221;) of which the prospective
qualified purchaser is a majority-owned subsidiary, or by a majority-owned subsidiary of the prospective qualified purchaser and other majority-owned subsidiaries of the Parent Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">In determining whether a natural person is a qualified purchaser, there may be included in the amount of such person&#8217;s
investments any investment held jointly with such person&#8217;s spouse, or investments in which such person shares with such person&#8217;s spouse a community property or similar shared ownership interest. In determining whether spouses who are
making a joint investment in the Fund are qualified purchasers, there may be included in the amount of each spouse&#8217;s investments any investments owned by the other spouse (whether or not such investments are held jointly). There shall be
deducted from the amount of any such investments any amounts specified by paragraph 2(a) of Appendix D incurred by such spouse. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">In determining whether a natural person is a qualified purchaser, there may be included in the amount of such person&#8217;s
investments any investments held in an individual retirement account or similar account the investments of which are directed by and held for the benefit of such person. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">As used in this Appendix C and Appendix D, the following terms shall have the meaning set forth below: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<I><U>Commodity Interests</U></I>&#8221; means commodity futures contracts, options on commodity futures contracts,
and options on physical commodities traded on or subject to the rules of: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">any contract market designated for trading such transactions under the Commodity Exchange Act and the rules
thereunder; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">any board of trade or exchange outside the United States, as contemplated in Part 30 of the rules under the
Commodity Exchange Act. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<I><U>Family Company</U></I>&#8221; means a company, partnership or
trust that owns not less than $5,000,000 in &#8220;<I>investments</I>&#8221; and that is owned directly or indirectly by or for two or more natural persons who are related as siblings or spouse (including former spouses), or direct lineal
descendants by birth or adoption, spouses of such persons, the estates of such persons, or foundations, charitable organizations or trusts established for the benefit of such persons. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<I><U>Financial Contract</U></I>&#8221; means any arrangement that: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">takes the form of an individually negotiated contract, agreement, or option to buy, sell, lend, swap, or
repurchase, or other similar individually negotiated transaction commonly entered into by participants in the financial markets; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">is in respect of securities, commodities, currencies, interest or other rates,
</P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">28 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="18%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt">
other measures of value, or any other financial or economic interest similar in purpose or function to any of the foregoing; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">is entered into in response to a request from a counter party for a quotation, or is otherwise entered into
and structured to accommodate the objectives of the counterparty to such arrangement. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<I><U>Physical Commodities</U></I>&#8221; means any physical commodity with respect to which a Commodity Interest is
traded on a market specified in the definition of Commodity Interests above. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<I><U>Public Company</U></I>&#8221;
means a company that: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">files reports pursuant to Section&nbsp;13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended from
time to time; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">has a class of securities that are listed on a Designated Offshore Securities Market, as defined by
Regulation S of the Securities Act. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:12%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<I><U>Related Person</U></I>&#8221; means a person who is
related to the prospective qualified purchaser as a sibling, spouse or former spouse, or is a direct lineal descendant or ancestor by birth or adoption of the prospective qualified purchaser, or is a spouse of such descendant or ancestor, provided
that, in the case of a Family Company, a Related Person includes any owner of the Family Company and any person who is a Related Person of such an owner. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">29 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Appendix D </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>Valuations of Investments </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">The general rule for determining the value of investments in order to ascertain whether an investor is a qualified purchaser is that the value
of the aggregate amount of investments owned and invested on a discretionary basis by the investor shall be their fair market value on the most recent practicable date or their cost. This general rule is subject to the following provisos: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(1)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">In the case of Commodity Interests, the amount of investments shall be the value of the initial margin or
option premium deposited in connection with such Commodity Interests; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(2)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">In each case, there shall be deducted from the amount of investments owned by the investor the following
amounts: </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">The amount of any outstanding indebtedness incurred to acquire the investments owned by the investor.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:11pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="12%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(b)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">A Family Company, in addition to the amounts specified in clause (a)&nbsp;above shall have deducted from the
value of such Family Company&#8217;s investments any outstanding indebtedness incurred by an owner of the Family Company to acquire such investments. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">30 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ANNEX I TO THE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>SUBSCRIBER QUESTIONNAIRE </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><div style="max-width:100%;margin-left:0%; margin-right:0%;border:solid 1px;background-color:;;padding-top:2pt;padding-bottom:3pt">
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; padding-top:12pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ALL SUBSCRIBERS, PLEASE FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS: </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:1%; margin-right:1%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I><U>ALL SUBSCRIBERS</U>: If you do not complete the Subscriber Questionnaire, your Subscription Agreement shall be

documents on behalf of this account, and telephone numbers. Without limiting the power of attorney contained in Section&nbsp;8 of the Subscription Agreement, if there are circumstances under which more than one signature is required to take action
with respect to this account, please state such circumstances. Requests to change the identity of persons authorized to act on behalf of a Member which is a corporation, partnership, trust, estate or other fiduciary must be accompanied by
appropriate documentation establishing the authority of the person seeking to act on behalf of the Subscriber. The Subscriber agrees that the Fund may rely on the information provided herein until it receives written notice of superseding

(i)&nbsp;any agency, authority, or instrumentality of the state or political subdivision, (ii)&nbsp;a plan or pool of assets controlled by the state or political subdivision or any agency, authority, or instrumentality thereof, and (iii)&nbsp;any
officer, agent, or employee of the state or political subdivision or any agency, authority, or instrumentality thereof acting in its official capacity. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>PART B: Status as Benefit Plan Investor </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a)&#8195;&#8194;<B><U>Overview</U></B><B><U>.</U></B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">The ERISA Plan Asset Regulation defines &#8220;<B><I>Benefit Plan Investor</I></B>&#8221;<I> </I>as: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(i)&#8195;&#8195;any employee benefit plan subject to Part&nbsp;4 of Subtitle&nbsp;B of Title&nbsp;I of ERISA; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(ii)&#8195;&#8195;any plan to which Section&nbsp;4975 of the Code applies (which includes a trust described in
Section&nbsp;401(a) of the Code that is exempt from tax under Section&nbsp;501(a) of the Code, a plan described in Section&nbsp;403(a) of the Code, an individual retirement account or annuity described in Section&nbsp;408 or&nbsp;408A of the Code, a
medical savings account described in Section&nbsp;220(d) of the Code, a health savings account described in Section&nbsp;223(d) of the Code and an education savings account described in Section&nbsp;530 of the Code); or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iii)&#8195;&#8195;a person or entity whose underlying assets include, or are deemed to include under the ERISA Plan Asset
Regulation or otherwise for purposes of Part&nbsp;4 of Subtitle&nbsp;B of Title&nbsp;I of ERISA or Section&nbsp;4975 of the Code, &#8220;plan assets&#8221; by reason of an investment in the person or entity by plans described in (a)(i) or (a)(ii)
immediately above. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">A person or entity described in (a)(iii) immediately above will be considered to hold &#8220;plan
assets&#8221; only to the extent of the percentage of the equity interests in the person or entity held by plans described in (a)(i) and (a)(ii) immediately above. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>(b)&#8195;&#8195;<U>Status as Benefit Plan Investor (Please Check Each as Applicable).</U> </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(i)&#8195;&#8195;The Subscriber is an ERISA Member (including by virtue of being a Public Plan Member, each as defined in the
LLC Agreement) for purposes of the LLC Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B><I>(Please check one.)</I></B>&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195;
Yes&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195; No </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(ii)&#8195;&#8195;Is the Subscriber an employee benefit plan subject to Part 4
of Subtitle B of Title I of ERISA? </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B><I>(Please check one.)</I></B>&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195;
Yes&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195; No </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iii)&#8195;&#8195;Is the Subscriber a plan to which Section&nbsp;4975 of the
Code applies? </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B><I>(Please check one.)</I></B>&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195;
Yes&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195; No </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iv)&#8195;&#8195;Is the Subscriber a governmental plan, <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-electing</FONT> church plan, or other employee benefit plan within the meaning of Section&nbsp;3(3) of ERISA that is not a plan described in (i)&nbsp;or (ii) above? </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B><I>(Please check one.)</I></B>&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195; Yes&#8195;&#8194; &#9744;&#8195;&#8195; No </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(v)&#8195;&#8195;Is the Subscriber an insurance company general account? </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATION AND SIGNATURE AUTHORIZATION </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">By acknowledging your consent below (and as long as you provide us with an electronic mail address) you consent to any and all
authorized contacts receiving electronic communications and understand that no paper copy will follow by mail. You agree that the authorized contacts listed in the Subscription Agreement (and any others you may subsequently identify) are specified
as your agents for the limited purpose of receiving, on your behalf, any electronic delivery including, but not limited to, account statements, performance reports, privacy notices, investment adviser brochures (Form ADV), disclosure documents and
any other information delivered or provided (i)&nbsp;by TCW Specialty Lending IX LLC, TCW Asset Management Company LLC or any of their Affiliates (collectively, &#8220;TCW&#8221;) in connection with the investment advisory services that TCW provides

to an <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> or any other electronic delivery address specified above or otherwise agreed between you and TCW. Until we have received notice of a change, we may continue to send information to the previous <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> or other electronic address, and any such information will be deemed to have been delivered, whether or not it is actually received. Additionally, you acknowledge and agree by acknowledging your consent below
that a successful transmission report received by TCW will constitute delivery of any communication. At your request, we will send you paper copies of any information we make available in electronic form. You may request paper copies by contacting
the Fund. You agree, however, that neither your request for, nor our deliver of, a paper copy will imply that the previous electronic delivery of the information did not constitute good and effective delivery. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Although TCW will take all appropriate measures to protect the confidentiality of any information transmitted through <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail,</FONT> please be advised that the facility to encrypt <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> messages is not available. Furthermore, the internet is not a secure environment and the use of Internet <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> carries with it a number of inherent risks. As a result, we cannot guarantee that <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> will be delivered within a reasonable time or at all; that <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> comes from the purported sender; that <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> is not intercepted by unauthorized or unintended third parties; that the content of the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> is unaltered from the time of transmission and therefore we cannot guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the information; or that the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> sent by us will
be free from viruses. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">You are responsible for having any necessary hardware, software or other technology to access
electronic communication. By acknowledging your consent below you acknowledge and agree that you are aware of and accept the risks associated with internet <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> and that the Fund&#8217;s agents, TCW, their
respective Affiliates and each of their respective partners, employees and agents will have no liability, contingent or otherwise, to you or any third party arising from or in any way related to the use of electronic communication. </P>

format (&#8220;PDF&#8221;), or other file formats we deem appropriate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><B>(</B><B><I>Please acknowledge your consent by

must match the name given on line 1 to avoid backup withholding. For individuals, this is generally your social security number (SSN). However, for a resident alien, sole proprietor, or disregarded entity, see the instructions for Part I, later. For
other entities, it is your employer identification number (EIN). If you do not have a number, see <I>How to get a TIN</I>, later.</P> <P STYLE="font-size:3pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:1pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Note:</B> If the account is in more than one name, see the instructions for line 1. See also <I>What Name and Number To</I> <I>Give the Requester </I>for
guidelines on whose number to enter.</P></TD>

</TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Under penalties of perjury, I certify that: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. The number shown on this form is my correct taxpayer identification number (or I am waiting for a number to be issued to me); and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. I am not subject to backup withholding because (a)&nbsp;I am exempt from backup withholding, or (b)&nbsp;I have not been notified by the Internal Revenue
Service (IRS) that I am subject to backup withholding as a result of a failure to report all interest or dividends, or (c)&nbsp;the IRS has notified me that I am no longer subject to backup withholding; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. I am a U.S. citizen or other U.S. person (defined below); and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. The FATCA code(s) entered on this form (if any) indicating that I am exempt from FATCA reporting is correct. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Certification instructions</B>. You must cross out item 2 above if you have been notified by the IRS that you are currently subject to backup withholding
because you have failed to report all interest and dividends on your tax return. For real estate transactions, item 2 does not apply. For mortgage interest paid, acquisition or abandonment of secured property, cancellation of debt, contributions to
an individual retirement arrangement (IRA), and, generally, payments other than interest and dividends, you are not required to sign the certification, but you must provide your correct TIN. See the instructions for Part II, later. </P>
